text:
jordan-cs: Heads up — large customer (AcmeCo) reporting repeated 5xx + timeouts hitting /v1/generate on hosted. Started ~20:30 UTC, ~30% of requests failing with 502/504. They sent request_ids: req_9f3a, req_a12b, req_f0c9.

maria-oncall: saw alerts for spike in gateway latency and a handful of 504s. Autoscaler didn't spin up in time. Oncall looking into routing + pool saturation.

sanjay-sre: grabbing traces now, can you paste a sample request payload and the exact endpoint path (route)?

jordan-cs: path is /v1/generate, model=redwood-large-16k, prompt lengths vary. sample payload (sanitized):

{
  "model": "redwood-large-16k",
  "input": "<customer prompt>",
  "max_tokens": 1024
}

jordan-cs: customer says failures correlate with longer prompts and streaming clients. They started seeing timeouts after a surge at 20:28 UTC.

kevin-runtime: initial quick check — upstream runtime nodes show increased queue depth and a few worker OOM restarts in the same window. KV cache eviction looks noisy around that time.

ana-eng: can you dump the gateway logs for req_9f3a? I'll correlate with runtime logs.

sanjay-sre: paste of gateway tail for req_9f3a:

[20:29:02] incoming request req_9f3a route=/v1/generate
[20:29:02] routed to pool: hosted-eu-west-1-pool-12
[20:29:05] backend timeout after 3000ms -> 504

kevin-runtime: runtime logs for same req show long GC pause and then worker restart:

[20:29:03] worker-7 processing token batch
[20:29:04] memory spike -> OOM signal
[20:29:05] worker-7 restarted (OOM)

maria-oncall: workaround options — 1) temporarily throttle long requests from the customer, 2) shift their traffic to a smaller model variant, 3) drain traffic from pool-12 and route to pool-9 (warm)

lucy-support: I'll ask AcmeCo to reduce max_tokens and enable reconnect/backoff for streaming clients while we stabilize. Need wording for customer comms.

jordan-cs: AcmeCo already temporarily reduced concurrency but still seeing tail failures. They need an ETA.

sanjay-sre: immediate mitigation plan enacted: (a) disabled large-batch packing for pool-12 to reduce memory spikes, (b) started traffic shift rule to route new AcmeCo sessions to pool-9, (c) bumped keepalive and worker restart thresholds to avoid noisy OOMs. Monitoring.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy started: runtime patch 2024-12-07T20:40Z -> disabling packing on pool-12

kevin-runtime: rolling patch applied to pool-12, confirmed no more OOM restarts for the last 6m. Queue depth back to normal. Still watching token-level latency.

maria-oncall: CS updated: "we applied a mitigation routing AcmeCo to a warm pool and disabled large-batch packing on the impacted pool. Expecting improved success rate within 5-10 minutes." cc @jordan-cs

jordan-cs: customer replied: errors dropping, thanks. They saw success on 80% of requests after the shift.

ana-eng: action items (short):
- increase autoscaler aggressiveness for pool-12-ish traffic profiles
- add synthetic test with streaming + long prompts hitting model redwood-large-16k
- investigate KV cache eviction pattern and packing heuristics
- add alert for worker OOM restarts (currently buried in infra logs)

sanjay-sre: assigning owners:
- autoscaler tuning -> kevin-runtime
- synthetic test + repro harness -> ana-eng
- KV eviction deep-dive -> me (sanjay-sre)
- customer comms follow-up -> lucy-support

lucy-support: I'll send a short email to AcmeCo with the mitigation details and offer 72 hours of credits. Draft:
"We routed your requests to a warm pool and disabled large-batch packing while we investigate memory pressure. You may see improved reliability. We're creating a dedicated synthetic test and will follow up with root cause and actions."

maria-oncall: follow-up timeline: quick monitoring (30m), postmortem in 24-48h if issue persists. Create incident ticket and schedule postmortem owners.

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-20241207-1717, severity: P2

ana-eng: quick repro note for postmortem: reproduce with streaming client, prompt length > 8k tokens, max_tokens=1024, high concurrency (10 concurrent streams) and packing enabled. I'll add harness to CI.

kevin-runtime: I'll prototype autoscaler change in canary, target faster scale-up for pool-12 class. Also adding a fallback routing rule to prefer empty warm pools for heavy seqlen requests.

jordan-cs: thanks all. tagging this thread for postmortem when we have the root cause. Please drop notes here if you find anything else.

sanjay-sre: preliminary hypothesis: packing + KV cache eviction + a latent memory leak on worker image causing transient OOM cascade under surge. Will validate with heap dumps and packing telemetry.

lucy-support: noted — sending comms now. :white_check_mark:

maria-oncall: closing war room for now — monitoring mode. If errors reappear reopen thread. :eyes:

jordan-cs: adding final checklist for postmortem doc:
- timeline + customer impact
- root cause hypothesis + evidence
- short-term mitigations (what we did)
- long-term fixes (autoscale, packing tweaks, revert memory regression if found)
- customer comms & credits
- owners + ETA

sanjay-sre: will post initial RCA draft in INC-20241207-1717 within 24h."
